# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report privately through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/lupinum-oss/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public issue. We aim to acknowledge reports within a week.

## Supported versions

Only the current `main` branch and the published handbook. Repositories generated from a starter are
independent afterwards; they pick up fixes through their own pull requests.
